provenance.source: www.in.gov/dwd/warn-notices/current-warn-notices/ (Indiana DWD WARN notices, full history table)
provenance.method: HTML table scrape (bs4), single page, robots.txt allowed
provenance.notes: Lane D freshness refresh of warn_notices/D19 (1,039 IN rows held in si_signals, observed 1994-05-12..2026-07-21; registry separately measured 1,220 IN rows in BigQuery for source_state=IN). Parsed 1220 rows from the current single-page table this run. ALL columns captured: ['Company', 'City', 'Affected Workers', 'Notice Date', 'LO/CL Date', 'NAICS', 'Description of Work/Industry', 'Notice Type', 'col_8']. Time-sensitivity payoff: 'LO/CL Date' (layoff/closure date) and 'Notice Type' (WARN vs CL) per row let a consumer identify notices whose layoff/closure has since occurred.

D12_code_violation (chronic problem property designations) | publisher_count=7 | South Bend Chronic Problem Properties List (municipal designation under city ordinance). OBSERVED EVENT DATE: Designation_Date (epoch ms). Address-keyed. Tiny list but the designation is a strong distress marker.

D12_code_violation (case-level, St. Joseph County - NEW county for D12) | publisher_count=20414 | South Bend Code Enforcement Cases 2018-2020 (Historic). State_ID__ = 18-digit state parcel id -> parcel-keyed. OBSERVED EVENT DATE: Record_Open_Date (epoch ms); Record_Status_Date = status-change date. Record_Type spans Litter/Grass and Weeds/housing etc - consumer must read Record_Type (a name is not a subject). Extends D12 beyond Marion County.

D12_code_violation (continuous-enforcement orders) | publisher_count=241 | South Bend Continuous Enforcement orders. PARCELID (county) + STATE_ID (18-digit state parcel id). OBSERVED EVENT DATE: HEARING__OR_LETTER_DATE; EXPIRATION_DATE bounds the order. Status Active/... kept verbatim.

D21_demolition (FIRST D21-type source held for Indiana) | publisher_count=80 | South Bend 'Demolition Orders (Historic / Non-Authoritative)' from data-southbend DCAT. Parcel-keyed: 'State' column IS the 18-digit state parcel id (71-...), 'County' is the county tax id - publisher swapped the labels, value-verified. OBSERVED EVENT DATES: Bid_Awarded_Date / Bid_Opening_Date (epoch ms when present). Sourced from the city's SharePoint code_enforcement/demolitions list. Snapshot, not live Accela.

D5_vacancy (city V&A program list w/ outcomes) | publisher_count=47 | South Bend 'All Vacant and Abandoned Properties (Historic / Non-Authoritative)'. State_ID_LU = 18-digit state parcel id. OBSERVED EVENT DATE: Added_to_V_A_on_ (program entry) and State_ID_LU_Date_of_Outcome (outcome). Condition codes + repair cost estimates included.

D19_warn extension: Indiana DWD current WARN notice list. Columns verbatim from page table: Company/City/Affected Workers/Notice Date/LO-CL Date/NAICS/Description/Notice Type + notice_pdf_urls. OBSERVED EVENT DATE = 'Notice Date'; 'LO/CL Date' is the announced layoff/closure effective date. Notice Type LO=layoff CL=closure. 1016/1220 rows have parseable Notice Date. Extends held D19 (1,039 rows) with current-period rows; dedupe on company+notice_date downstream.
